bootstrap_review: Exact frozen stream and CC/CW/WC/WW categories; independent counts/linear contrast/Wilson algebra. This is not an independent Monte Carlo sample.
conditional_interval_scope: Conditional on fixed checkpoints and these IID/exchangeable questions. Shared activity/context dependence (including HellaSwag) is uncorrected; these are not training-replicate or automatic population CIs.
seed_scope: Sample SD across the three fixed training seeds, separate final/best. Aliases and questions are not extra seeds; A lambda-selection variability is not resampled.
